mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above its 5-year moving average precedes a short-term decline in S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to expectations of tighter policy and reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-year monthly moving average
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window following the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-trigger mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS for two consecutive months indicate a disinflationary trend that is associated with higher S&P 500 60-day forward returns as investors price in lower future inflation risk.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases for two consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS also decreases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Across 12 consecutive 60-day windows post-trigger, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the pre-trigger average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in PAYEMS (labor market additions) accompanied by a concurrent drop in UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals a strengthening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as optimism about job growth outweighs wage concerns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 10% in a month AND UNRATE falls by at least 0.5 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: Over 20 consecutive 5-day windows following the trigger, SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 (real private consumption) coinciding with a decline in RSAFS (durable goods orders) suggests mixed demand signals; if the GDPC1 acceleration persists for 20 days, it predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as growth expectations are reaffirmed.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by at least 3% month-over-month AND RSAFS decreases by at least 5% month-over-month
regime_hint: mixed demand indicators turning toward growth
failure_condition: In 10 consecutive 20-day windows after the trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) for three consecutive months, while HOUST (housing starts) remains flat or rising, predicts negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as it signals weakening manufacturing momentum and muted housing recovery.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for three consecutive months AND HOUST does not decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 12 consecutive 60-day windows post-trigger, SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for 20 consecutive trading days in a non-recessionary context, it predicts a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as low unemployment is interpreted as a structural labor market improvement.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE remains below 4% for 20 consecutive trading days
failure_condition: Across 10 such 20-day windows in the next year, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp and immediate drop in FEDFUNDS accompanied by a sharp rise in HOUST (housing starts) suggests that the Fed's rate cut is stimulating credit and housing activity, which in turn drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops by at least 0.25 percentage points in a single month AND HOUST increases by at least 5% in the same month
failure_condition: In 15 consecutive 5-day windows after the trigger, SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 for four consecutive months, without a compensating rise in CPIAUCSL, predicts negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as it signals broad economic softening.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for four consecutive months AND GDPC1 decreases for four consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL does not increase for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 8 consecutive 60-day windows post-trigger, SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05).
